payload.title: Build dashboard links from PRIMUS_APP_URL instead of hardcoded domains
payload.description:
Replace hardcoded dashboard links (the retired app.plexusanalytics.com, and a client-specific lab domain in 9 places) with a helper, primus/utils/dashboard_urls.py, that builds links from the PRIMUS_APP_URL environment variable.

PR: https://github.com/AnthusAI/Primus/pull/632 (branch claude/project-thread-2eqg2r, base develop).
